messages.subject: Any one want a piecepackr logo sticker?
messages.subject_clean: Any one want a piecepackr logo sticker?
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

* I made some hexagonal piecepackr logo stickers to hand out at an R conference I'm going to.
* Does anyone want one?  If you send me a mailing address I can mail one to you.
* They are pretty small (2" from top vertex to bottom vertex) and should meet the hexagon (laptop) sticker standard: https://sticker.how/

Best,

Trevor
